shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "=== TREE ===" && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100 && echo "=== PKG ===" && cat package.json

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo "=== CALENDAR ENTRIES ===" && grep -n -i -C 4 'date-components\|calendar' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,120p && echo "=== APP ===" && cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html AGENTS.md && echo "=== TRAPS ===" && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo "=== NODE_MODULES ===" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"'

npm install @gravity-ui/date-components @gravity-ui/date-utils 2>&1 | tail -5 && echo "=== VERSIONS ===" && grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/package.json && echo "=== PEERS ===" && node -e "const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/package.json');console.log(JSON.stringify(p.peerDependencies,null,1))" && echo "=== DOCS ===" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/docs 2>&1 | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/
sed -n 1,60p /home/node/.npm/_logs/2026-11-04T08_59_30_028Z-eresolve-report.txt; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -30

npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[]",' | tr -s ' \n' ' ' | fold -w 200; echo; for v in 4.0.0 3.3.0 3.0.0; do echo "--- $v"; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@$v peerDependencies 2>/dev/null; done

npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@4.1.0 peerDependencies 2>/dev/null && npm install @gravity-ui/date-components@^4.1.0 @gravity-ui/date-utils@^2.6.0 2>&1 | tail -3 && echo "=== VERSIONS ===" && node -e "for (const p of ['date-components','date-utils']) console.log(p, require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/'+p+'/package.json').version)" && echo "=== DOCS ===" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/docs 2>&1 | head

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components; echo "=== README (setup) ==="; grep -n -i -A 12 'install\|required setup\|usage' $D/README.md | head -60; echo "=== INDEX ==="; cat $D/dist/docs/INDEX.md | head -80; echo "=== COMPONENTS ==="; ls $D/dist/docs/components; echo "=== CALENDAR DOC ==="; cat $D/dist/docs/components/Calendar/README.md 2>/dev/null || find $D/dist/docs -iname '*calendar*'

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components; wc -l $D/dist/docs/components/Calendar.md; cat $D/dist/docs/components/Calendar.md; echo "=== CSS FILES ==="; find $D/dist -maxdepth 2 -name '*.css' | head; echo "=== PACKAGE EXPORTS/style ==="; node -e "const p=require('./$D/package.json');console.log(p.main,p.module,JSON.stringify(p.exports||null,null,1), p.sideEffects)"; echo "=== date-utils dateTime sig ==="; grep -n 'export declare function dateTime\|export declare const dateTime' -A 6 node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm; ls $D/components/Calendar/; grep -n 'onUpdate\|value?:\|selectionMode\|CalendarProps' $D/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts $D/components/Calendar/hooks/*.d.ts $D/components/Calendar/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "=== DateTime.format ==="; grep -n '    format(' -A 2 node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/build/typings/dateTime.d.ts | head; echo "=== uikit Text variants ==="; grep -n 'TEXT_VARIANTS\|header-1\|subheader' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -5
